_comment: subnet-repo-fleet policy. `clone_root`/`db` are relative to the repo root (gitignored var/). `caps` bound each untrusted clone (bytes via git object size; files via tree entry count) — a breach quarantines the slot. `min_free_bytes` is the disk ceiling: below it, new clones are held as `disk-limited` and retried when space frees. `max_new_clones_per_pass` spreads cold-start across passes. `unreachable_backoff_hours` throttles repos that will not clone (placeholder URLs, private repos the public-read-only token cannot see, deleted/moved) with an escalating retry delay per consecutive failure — a fix (new repo URL) changes the fingerprint and re-points immediately, bypassing the backoff. `update_interval_hours` × `stale_multiplier` drives per-slot staleness. GITHUB_TOKEN (optional) is read from the 0600 .env at runtime, never from here.
